tools.name: extsearch_find
tools.description: Search the Cortico extension market (the official index behind the Extensions page) for extensions. Fuzzy-matches keywords against names, tags and descriptions and returns ranked candidates with short descriptions. Without query, lists everything that passes the filters by downloads.

query.description: A few keywords for what the user wants, space-separated; Chinese and English both work (e.g. "语音 tts voice"). Not a whole sentence.

kind.description: world: connects the pet to an app, platform or capability; provider: a model service; bot: a whole persona.

tag.description: Only extensions with this market tag, by id or label (e.g. "voice", "game", "语音").

summary.zh: 按关键词在扩展市场里模糊搜索扩展，返回候选和简介。
summary.en: Fuzzy-searches the extension market by keywords and returns candidates with descriptions.

tools.name: extsearch_detail
tools.description: Full market entry of one extension by its exact npm package name: both language descriptions, author, license, platforms, tags, version, tool/event counts, rating and links.

name.description: Exact npm package name from extsearch_find.

summary.zh: 查看某个扩展在市场里的完整信息。
summary.en: Shows the full market entry of one extension.

prompts.title: 扩展市场搜索 · 环境提示词
prompts.content: 用户询问有没有能做某件事的扩展（插件），或描述了一个模糊的需求时，调用 extsearch_find 在 Cortico 扩展市场里搜索。
